content.text:
All migration patterns are clean. Here is a summary of what was done:

---

**Migration complete across 5 files:**

**`server/src/routes/workspace-command-authz.ts`**
- Removed `import type { Request } from "express"`
- Added `import type { AuthzReq } from "./authz.js"`
- Changed `assertNoAgentHostWorkspaceCommandMutation(req: Request, ...)` to accept `AuthzReq`
- Changed `req.actor.type` to `req.actor?.type` for optional chaining

**`server/src/routes/workspace-runtime-service-authz.ts`**
- Removed `import type { Request } from "express"`
- Added `type AuthzReq` from `./authz.js`
- Changed all three exported functions (`assertAgentCanManageRuntimeServicesForWorkspace`, `assertCanManageProjectWorkspaceRuntimeServices`, `assertCanManageExecutionWorkspaceRuntimeServices`) to accept `AuthzReq` instead of `Request`
- Updated `req.actor.type/agentId` accesses to optional-chain `req.actor?.type/agentId`

**`server/src/routes/goals.ts`**
- Removed `import type { Request } from "express"` and all `ctx as unknown as Request` casts
- Pass `ctx` directly to `assertCompanyAccess(ctx, ...)` and `getActorInfo(ctx)` — both accept `AuthzReq` which `RequestCtx` satisfies structurally
- Added `as any` casts where `ctx.json()` returns `unknown` but the service expects a typed input (mirrors pre-existing `req.body: any` behavior)

**`server/src/routes/projects.ts`**
- Removed `import type { Request } from "express"` (kept `Request`, `ExpressResponse`, `NextFunction` for the `router.param` callback signature)
- Converted `resolveCompanyIdForProjectReference` and `normalizeProjectReference` to accept `RequestCtx` instead of `Request`
- Removed all `const req = ctx as unknown as Request` patterns inside Handler functions
- Pass `ctx` directly to `assertCompanyAccess`, `getActorInfo`, `assertNoAgentHostWorkspaceCommandMutation`, `assertCanManageProjectWorkspaceRuntimeServices`
- `router.param` callback keeps a legitimate `req as unknown as RequestCtx` cast since Express middleware still runs there

**`server/src/routes/companies.ts`**
- Removed `import type { Request } from "express"` and all `const req = ctx as unknown as Request` patterns
- Added `import type { BoardActor }` for narrowing after `assertBoard()` calls
- After each `assertBoard(ctx)` call, added `const boardActor = ctx.actor as BoardActor` to access `BoardActor`-specific fields (`isInstanceAdmin`, `companyIds`, `userId`) with correct typing
- All helpers (`assertImportTargetAccess`, `assertCanUpdateBranding`, `assertCanManagePortability`) now take `RequestCtx` directly

No new TypeScript errors were introduced — all remaining errors in these files are pre-existing environment-level issues (missing `@types/node`, missing workspace packages).
